evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines system response when correlation request is rejected — an exception condition in cross-link track identifier handling.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs responding with a reverse correlation shall transmit the J7.2 message with the originally received Retained TN and Dropped TN reversed and the RV field set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes alternative successful path (reverse correlation) triggered by specific input conditions — qualifies as exception flow since it diverges from standard acceptance.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs not holding the Dropped TN shall not take any further action.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies no-action exception path when required data (Dropped TN) is missing — prevents invalid processing.

evidence_cards.content: If the Retained TN is not held but the Dropped TN is held, the correlation request shall be processed as follows: (1) If the Dropped TN has an OCC... (a) If RV=0, transmit reverse correlation with RV=1; (b) If RV=1, transmit rejection with RV=2; (c) If RV=3, execute correlation using Dropped TN data and Retained TN track number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details conditional exception handling based on presence/absence of Retained TN and RV value — covers multiple error/recovery paths.

evidence_cards.content: If the Dropped TN does not have an OCC, execute the correlation using Dropped TN data and Retained TN track number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Fallback execution path when OCC is absent — represents recovery behavior under partial data availability.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs rejecting a J7.2 message and holding the Dropped TN as a local or common local track shall not interpret the J7.2 message as a Drop Track message for the purpose of determining R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Prevents misinterpretation of rejection messages as drop commands — avoids unintended side effects during exception handling.

evidence_cards.content: If the received J7.2 message contains one or both of the same TNs as contained in the transmission of the own unit J7.2 message sequence in progress, the following actions shall be taken:
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Initiates exception handling for duplicate/conflicting TNs in concurrent message sequences — prevents race conditions or state corruption.

evidence_cards.content: A code of all zeroes (00 or 0000) is illegal for use as an assigned operational IFF/SIF Mode I, II, or III code.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific data validity constraint that would trigger an exception if violated during IFF/SIF reporting or processing.

evidence_cards.content: Any IFF/SIF Mode I, II, or III Code field set to all zeroes indicates that the reporting unit has no data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the system's interpretation of an invalid/zeroed code field, distinguishing between an illegal assignment and a 'no data' status.

evidence_cards.content: If the requested data has been transmitted by another JU, the remaining JUs need not respond with their local data.

source_locations.location: paragraph c under IFF/SIF UPDATE REQUESTS

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an exception condition where a JU is exempt from responding to a request if another unit has already provided the data, which constitutes an alternative or exception flow path in the update process.

evidence_cards.content: The correlation shall be deemed to have failed if no J7.0 (ACT = 0) is received for the dropped TN after a period of 60 seconds from the transmission of the correlation request and all associated processing for the correlation shall be cancelled.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an explicit failure condition (timeout) and system response (cancellation) for the correlation process, which constitutes an exception flow path.

evidence_cards.content: If the Dropped TN is reported by another IU after transmission of the J7.0, own unit shall retain the Dropped TN as a remote track and shall not reattempt to correlate the Retained TN and the Dropped TN for a period of 60 seconds after transmission of the J7.0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a constraint preventing re-correlation under specific conditions (external reporting), representing a deviation from normal flow handling.

evidence_cards.content: A system should have a mechanism to purge remote tracks when it does not receive a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and receives no further updates on the remote track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the exception handling procedure for missing termination messages (J7.0 ACT=0), which is an error or unexpected condition path for track management.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.1 message can be used to request space track state vector or covariance data by setting the Action, Data Update Request field to value 2.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an alternative use case for the J7.1 message (requesting space track data) which is outside the scope of the current 'Request Cross-Link Track Identifiers' use case, thereby confirming that the exception flow for invalid request types or unsupported actions is not covered here but rather defines a separate valid path.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.1 message with ACT=1 or ACT=2 is addressed to a specific Addressee TN(s) or to the collective address of 00177 octal.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies addressing constraints; if a JU attempts to send to an invalid address format, it would constitute an exception, though the document does not explicitly describe the error handling behavior for invalid addresses in this section.

evidence_cards.content: Receiving IUs shall accept the requested correlation unless certain prespecified conditions exist which require or allow the receiving IU to reject the requested correlation or respond with a reverse correlation request.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the condition under which an exception flow (rejection) is triggered for a correlation request, which serves as an error handling path for the track identifier exchange process.

evidence_cards.content: Whenever a correlation request is rejected the J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 2 shall be transmitted to report the rejection.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the system response and message format required when an exception (rejection) occurs.

evidence_cards.content: A code of all zeroes (00 or 0000) is illegal for use as an assigned operational IFF/SIF Mode I, II, or III code.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a specific data validation exception condition that prevents the acceptance of certain IFF/SIF codes, constituting an error handling path.

evidence_cards.content: Any IFF/SIF Mode I, II, or III Code field set to all zeroes indicates that the reporting unit has no data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the system interpretation and response when the illegal zero-code condition is encountered, completing the exception flow definition.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.2 Correlation message shall not be inhibited by any filter.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines an exception to the general rule that filters inhibit transmission; it specifies a condition (J7.2 message) under which inhibition does not occur, relevant for error/exception handling in track reporting.

evidence_cards.content: After successful completion of the correlation test, a local track is considered to correlate to the closest remote track or IU that meets all of the correlation tests, subject to the correlation restrictions in paragraph 4.4.4.3.1g and the requirement to pass two correlation tests in paragraph 4.4.4.3.1h.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the observable system state (correlation established) after successfully completing the correlation testing process, which constitutes the postcondition for this use case.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN, the JU controlling the TN shall transmit the appropriate J10 Weapons Coordination and Management messages and J13 Platform and System Status messages.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system response state for the controlling unit after receiving a data update request, which serves as a postcondition for the successful completion of the request use case.

evidence_cards.content: All C2 JUs receiving a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message containing their own TN shall transmit J10.2 Engagement Status messages to report the status of all engagements they are conducting and a J13 Platform and System Status message to report their own status.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific post-transaction state for the primary actor (C2 JU) when it is the subject of the request, requiring the transmission of engagement and status reports.

evidence_cards.content: The latest Link 11/11B, NATO Link 1 TN, ATDL-1 TN, or IJMS SRN received on a track shall supersede previously received data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the observable system state change after a J7.4 report is successfully processed in response to a request: the new cross-link identifier replaces any older one for that track.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU has successfully requested the selected cross-link track identifier using the J7.4 message.

source_locations.location: Page content does not contain specific postcondition evidence for the J7.4 Request Cross-Link Track Identifiers use case; this claim is derived from the success boundary defined in the goal slot context (EC-G-008) which states 'The C2 JU has requested the selected cross-link track identifier using the J7.4 message' as the success condition.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the successful end state of the use case where the request has been issued.

evidence_cards.content: A local track is considered to correlate to the closest remote track or IU that meets all of the correlation tests.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the immediate observable system state (correlation established) resulting from a successful correlation test process, which serves as the postcondition for the use case.

evidence_cards.content: If the J7.1 Addressee TN is set to value 00177, JUs with R² transmit all J3.7 EW data on the TN or as specified by the Request Indicator set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific system response (postcondition) for a successful request where the target is an external track (TN 00177).

evidence_cards.content: If the J7.1 Addressee TN is set to own JU, transmit all J3.7 EW data on the TN or as specified by the Request Indicators, with the J3.7 Response Indicator set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific system response (postcondition) for a successful request where the target is the local unit (own JU).

evidence_cards.content: If the J7.1 Addressee TN is set to value 00177, JUs with R² transmit all J3.7 EW data on the TN or as specified by the Request Indicator set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a specific system state change (transmission of J3.7 EW data) that occurs after receiving a J7.1 request message, which constitutes a postcondition for the interaction.

evidence_cards.content: If the J7.1 Addressee TN is set to own JU, transmit all J3.7 EW data on the TN or as specified by the Request Indicators, with the J3.7 Response Indicator set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies another successful outcome where J3.7 EW data is transmitted and the Response Indicator is set to value 1, representing a concrete postcondition of the use case execution.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.4 report message may be transmitted by any JU in response to a J7.4 request message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the successful system response (report transmission) that occurs after the use case (request) is completed.

evidence_cards.content: The latest Link 11/11B, NATO Link 1 TN, ATDL-1 TN, or IJMS SRN received on a track shall supersede previously received data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the postcondition state of the system regarding data updates following the receipt of the requested identifiers.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU has successfully transmitted a J7.5 (ACT = 2) IFF/SIF Update Request message to request the update of specific mode indicators.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the successful completion state for the 'Request' use case variant: the operator action results in the transmission of the specific request message (J7.5 ACT=2).

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU has requested the selected cross-link track identifier using the J7.4 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state after successful completion of the use case: the request for a specific cross-link track identifier type (e.g., Link 11/11B TN) via J7.4 has been issued by the C2 JU.
